_why: Visual lane (3 Nov 2026), P2-002 / F38#4 map (CPU v1/ui1a 5.73; all three judges: 'a green disc on cloud fog with road lines, no terrain, groves, water or buildings'). On: the map bake (scripts/world/map_baker.gd, shared by the minimap and the full map) adds a north-west hillshade, canopy painted from the scatter bake's tree layers (trees, grove; every other layer skipped while reading), and a fixed painterly grain. OFF leaves the bake byte-identical; its bytes join the cache key so turning it on rebakes once. OFF until judged.
